name: EPIC 220647440
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 7.6 solar radii and 0.89 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 1,934 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.89 solar masses and 7.6 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 5,166 K at its surface.
